english.note: Use this when the secretive behavior looks suspicious or furtive, especially of a person moving around unnoticed.

examples.english: Their surreptitious behavior outside the building made us call the police.
examples.traditional: 佢哋成晚喺大廈門口鬼鬼祟祟咁行，我哋即刻報警。
